_about: Read once (read-only) from o/demo collections -OY1WWp6j0VZJog3B3nC (stories) and -OlNvf6tnfenPpv5czqv (funds) on 2026-10-28. Renamed for Harbor Lights: student Emily Johnson -> Grace Johnson (clashed with donor Emily Wilson); a leftover placeholder phrase removed from one bio. The form fields are authored for the demo so each saves to the variable the stories already use; the source collection still had the default Collect fields. Majors and notes adjusted 2026-10-28 so each student fits their fund (review: Health Sciences funded an engineering major).

form.title: Share your scholarship story
form.description: Tell the donors who fund your scholarship what it has meant to you. Your story may appear in our 2026 Impact Report.

fields.label: Your note to the donors who made this possible
fields.name: student_note

stories.short_bio: A first-generation college student passionate about community health research.
stories.student_note: I am so grateful for your generous support. As a first-generation college student, your contribution has opened doors I never imagined possible. Because of your gift, I can focus on my studies in Biology and spend my summers in a research lab instead of a second job. Your kindness inspires me to give back and support others in the future.

stories.short_bio: Aspiring software engineer with an interest in AI and data science.
stories.student_note: Thank you so much for your generosity. Your support allows me to pursue my passion for computer science and research in artificial intelligence. Outside of class, I enjoy coding projects and mentoring younger students who are just discovering technology. Your gift not only helps me today but will also make an impact through the work I hope to do in the future.

stories.short_bio: Nursing student and clinical volunteer at a community health center.
stories.student_note: I want to sincerely thank you for supporting students like me. With your help, I have been able to spend more time in clinical training and less time worrying about tuition. Every patient I meet reminds me why I chose nursing, and your gift is part of every one of those moments.

stories.short_bio: Incoming student excited to study how communities stay healthy.
stories.student_note: Thank you so much for your generosity. As a new student just starting my journey, I am excited to study public health and learn how good policy keeps whole communities healthier. Your support makes it possible for me to focus on that from my very first semester.

stories.short_bio: Varsity runner and campus leader in student government.

funds.fund_description: Supports undergraduate scholarships across all disciplines..
Provides funding for student and faculty research in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.
Supports programs, exhibitions, and performances in the arts and humanities.
Funds initiatives in nursing, medicine, and public health, including new lab equipment and fellowships.
Provides long-term support for student-athlete scholarships and athletic program development.
